trap.label: keep + -ing
trap.wrong: She keeps to call me every day.
trap.right: She keeps calling me every day.
trap.why: Em português "continua a ligar" lembra infinitivo. Em inglês, keep é seguido de -ing.

fix.wrong: He keeps to ask the same question.
fix.right: He keeps asking the same question.

fix.wrong: We kept in touch with each other for years to.
fix.right: We kept in touch for years.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com keep: “She continues to talk.”
Reescreva com keep in touch: “We stay in contact.”
